• Interest payments include the **interest paid on loans** taken by the government, such as external debt and domestic debt.
 
• Defence services include expenses related to the **maintenance and modernization of armed forces**, as well as the payment of salaries and pensions to defence personnel.
 
• Subsidies include various types of **subsidies given by the government,** such as food subsidies, fertilizer subsidies, and fuel subsidies.

• **Household expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred by households on various** goods and services,** such as food, clothing, and housing.

questions.question: India has a parliamentary form of government which is a feature borrowed from the ________ Constitution.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __** Britain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's parliamentary form **of government is heavily influenced by the **British parliamentary **system, which was introduced during the** colonial period.**
 
• The Indian Constitution lays down the framework for the parliamentary system, which is based on the **Westminster model **of the British Parliament.
 
• The Indian Parliament consists of two houses, the **Lok Sabha **and the **Rajya Sabha, **which are similar to the **House of Commons** and the **House of Lords** in the **British Parliament.**
 
• The **Indian Prime Minister** is the **head of the government** and is selected by the majority party or coalition in the Lok Sabha, similar to the role of the British Prime Minister.
 
• The British Constitution is an **unwritten constitution**, which means that it is **not codified** in a single document.
 
• Instead, it is based on a collection of **laws, customs, and conventions** that have evolved over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **South Africa **has a parliamentary system of government, but it is **not** based on the British model.

 
 
• The South African Constitution was adopted in **1996 **and is a hybrid of **parliamentary and presidential** systems.
 
 
 
• The **United States** has a** presidential system** of government, which is based on the separation of powers between the **executive, legislative, and judicial branches** of government.
 
 
• The US Constitution was adopted in **1787** and is the **oldest written** constitution in the world.
 
 
 
• **Australia **also has a **parliamentary system** of government, but it is a hybrid of the **British and American models.**
 
 
• The Australian Constitution was adopted in **1901 **and is based on the Westminster model of the British Parliament, but it also incorporates elements of **federalism and separation of powers.**

questions.question: Savitribai, together with her husband Jyotirao Phule, founded one of India's first girls' schools in Pune, at Bhide Wada in _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1848.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Savitribai** and her husband **Jyotirao Phule** were **social reformers** who worked towards the **upliftment of women** and** lower-caste **communities in India.
 
• They founded one of India's first girls' schools in **Pune, Maharashtra, **which was established in **1848 at Bhide Wada**.
 
• The school aimed to provide **education to girls** who were otherwise denied access to learning opportunities due to** social and cultural **barriers.
 
• The school **faced opposition** from conservative elements in society, who believed that educating girls was against traditional values and norms.
 
• However, Savitribai and Jyotirao **persisted **in their efforts and continued to expand the school's reach.
 
• Over time, their work inspired the establishment of other **schools and educational institutions** for girls across India, and they are now widely recognized as pioneers of women's education in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Savitribai Phule was the **first female teacher in India** and played a significant role in promoting **women's education **in the country.
 
• She was also a** poet** and wrote several **poems on social issues** such as caste discrimination, women's rights, and education.
 
• Savitribai and Jyotirao Phule also established the **Satyashodhak Samaj,** a social reform organization that worked towards the emancipation of **lower-caste communities** in India.
 
• The couple faced **opposition and criticism **from conservative elements in society for their progressive views and actions, but they continued to work towards their goals with determination and courage.

questions.question: Except for the deep sea hydrothermal ecosystem, sun is the only source of energy for all ecosystems on Earth. What comes next in the energy food chain?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Plants.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **energy food chain **starts with the **sun**, which is the **primary source of energy** for all ecosystems on Earth.
 
• **Plants**, being the **primary producers,** are the next in the energy food chain.
 
• They use the sun's energy to produce food through** photosynthesis.**
 
• **Herbivores** come next in the chain, as they **consume plants **for their energy requirements.
 
• **Carnivores **come after herbivores, as they **consume other animals** for their energy requirements.
 
• Man is a** part** of the food chain, but not necessarily a next step.
 
• **Humans** can be herbivores or carnivores depending on their dietary habits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Herbivores** are animals that consume only plants as their **primary source of energy.**
 
• **Carnivores** are animals that consume other animals as their** primary source of energy.**
 
• **A food chain** is a straight line of living things that are eaten by other species to transfer **nutrients and energy.**
 
• Each organism in a food chain belongs to a distinct trophic level, which is determined by the number of energy transfers that separate it from the chain's fundamental input.

• **Babur **was a **Mongol prince** who founded the** Mughal Empire** in India in **1526** after **defeating Ibrahim Lodi**, the Sultan of Delhi, at the **battle of Panipat.**
 
• The battle of Panipat was a significant event in Indian history as it marked the **beginning of the Mughal Empire,** which lasted for more than 300 years and left a lasting impact on **Indian culture, art, and architecture.**
 
• Babur's victory at Panipat was mainly due to his **superior military tactics **and the** use of artillery**, which was a relatively new technology in India at that time.
 
• Babur's descendants, including **Akbar, Jahangir, and Shah Jahan**, continued to expand and consolidate the Mughal Empire, which reached its **zenith under Aurangzeb** in the late 17th century.

• Hemu was arrested, rendered nearly lifeless, and then **executed by Akbar, **who adopted the name Ghazi.

questions.question: Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days. Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days. Find the number of days in which Pramod can complete the same work.
questions.solution:

Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days.

Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days.

**Concept:**

Work done is directly proportional to the number of days and the number of workers.

**Solution:**

⇒ The combined rate of Pramod, Akhil, and Raman = 1/14 work/day

⇒ The combined rate of Akhil and Raman = 1/77 work/day

⇒ The rate of Pramod = 1/14 - 1/77 = 9/154 work/day

questions.question: The average age of husband and wife is 24 years. The age of their son is 1/9th of the age of the husband. The wife is 6 years younger to the husband. Find the average age of all three members of family.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average age of husband and wife = 24 years

Age of their son is 1/9th of the age of the husband

Wife is 6 years younger than the husband

**Concept:**

Average age = Total age/Number of individuals

**Solution:**

⇒ Total age of husband and wife = 24 years × 2 = 48 years

⇒ Age of husband = (48 years + 6 years)/2 = 27 years

⇒ Age of son = 27 years/9 = 3 years

⇒ Total age of all three = 48 years + 3 years = 51 years

⇒ Average age of all three = 51 years/3 = 17 years

**Hence, the average age of all three members of the family is 17 years.**

questions.question: Due to leakage in a tank, there are 220 liters of water left in the tank which originally held 240 liters. What is percent loss of water?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Original amount of water = 240 liters

Amount of water left due to leakage = 220 liters

**Concept:**

Percentage loss = (Initial Quantity - Final Quantity)/initial Quantity × 100%

**Solution:**

⇒ Percentage loss = (240 liters - 220 liters)/240 liters × 100% = 20/240 × 100% = 8.33%

**Hence, the percent loss of water is 8.33%.**
